title: Rabbi Zeira bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Keritot 27a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.27a.24): he reviewed his learning every thirty days before Rabbi Yochanan. But Hyman says the reading should be Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada, as in [Berakhot 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.38b.10) and [Chullin 86b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.86b.5).[^1]

notes.text: Keritot names Zeira bar Ada and leaves his teacher implicit in this line. The other two passages name Chiyya bar Abba reviewing before Yochanan every thirty days. Hyman proposes Chiyya bar Ada. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1117&lang=en) directs the reader to Chiyya bar Abba.
